subsections.title: Developer Dashboard
subsections.content:
The Conflux Paymaster Developer Dashboard is a multi-tenant platform where dApp developers can:

  • Register their dApp - Sign up and create a project
  • Get an API Key - Receive a unique API key for usage tracking
  • Deposit Funds - Add CFX to sponsor user gas fees
  • Monitor Usage - Track transactions and spending via charts

Onboarding Flow:

  1. Visit Login and connect your wallet
  2. If new, you'll be directed to Sign Up
  3. Enter your project name, type, and description
  4. After registration, you'll receive an API key
  5. Deposit CFX to your paymaster balance
  6. Use the API key in your SDK integration

Project Types Supported:

  • DeFi
  • NFT Marketplace
  • Game
  • Social Network
  • Wallet
  • Crypto Exchange
  • DAO
  • Launchpad
  • Other

2% Fee: A 2% fee is applied on all deposits to support platform development. The fee wallet is: 0x059c159c1061C3cd082d020e0F77260234A3f523

subsections.title: What is Conflux Paymaster SDK?
subsections.content:
Conflux Paymaster SDK is an open-source TypeScript library that enables any Conflux eSpace dApp to sponsor gas fees for its users. Built on the ERC-4337 Account Abstraction standard, it eliminates the biggest barrier to Web3 adoption: requiring users to hold CFX just to transact.

Key Features:

  • Gasless Transactions: dApps sponsor all user gas fees
  • Smart Accounts: ERC-4337 compatible smart accounts
  • TypeScript First: Full type safety and IntelliSense
  • Open Source: MIT licensed
  • Conflux Native: Purpose-built for eSpace

subsections.title: Installation
subsections.content:
Install via npm:

npx jsr add @conflux-paymaster/conflux-paymaster-sdk

Or using pnpm:

pnpm i jsr:@conflux-paymaster/conflux-paymaster-sdk

Or using yarn:

yarn dlx jsr add @conflux-paymaster/conflux-paymaster-sdk

Or using bun:

bunx jsr add @conflux-paymaster/conflux-paymaster-sdk

Or using deno:

deno add @conflux-paymaster/conflux-paymaster-sdk

Peer Dependencies:

  • viem (^2.0.0) - Required for wallet connections
  • ethers (^6.0.0) - Optional, for alternative WalletClient

subsections.title: Quick Start
subsections.content:
Initialize the SDK and send a gasless transaction:

import { ConfluxPaymaster } from '@conflux-paymaster/conflux-paymaster-sdk';

const paymaster = new ConfluxPaymaster({
  rpcUrl: 'https://evmtestnet.confluxrpc.com',
  paymasterAddress: '0x0cDE16Cf1fD5Bf2536069Aec8a2eF0832A27577B',
  signingServiceUrl: 'https://conflux-paymaster.onrender.com',
  chainId: 71,
  apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY'  // Get from dashboard
});

// Connect user's wallet
await paymaster.connect(userPrivateKey);

// Send gasless transaction
const result = await paymaster.sendTransaction({
  to: tokenAddress,
  data: encodedData,
  value: 0n
});

console.log('UserOp Hash:', result.userOpHash);

That's it! The user never sees a gas fee prompt.

subsections.title: PaymasterConfig
subsections.content:
The ConfluxPaymaster constructor takes a PaymasterConfig object:

interface PaymasterConfig {
  rpcUrl: string;           // Conflux eSpace RPC (testnet/mainnet)
  paymasterAddress: string; // Deployed VerifyingPaymaster address
  signingServiceUrl: string; // Your backend signing service URL
  chainId: 71 | 1030;       // 71 = testnet, 1030 = mainnet
  bundlerUrl?: string;      // Optional custom bundler URL
  entryPointAddress?: string; // Optional custom EntryPoint
}

Example Configuration:

const config: PaymasterConfig = {
  rpcUrl: 'https://evmtestnet.confluxrpc.com',
  paymasterAddress: '0x0cDE16Cf1fD5Bf2536069Aec8a2eF0832A27577B',
  signingServiceUrl: 'https://conflux-paymaster.onrender.com',
  chainId: 71,
};

subsections.title: ConfluxPaymaster Class
subsections.content:
Constructor

new ConfluxPaymaster(config: PaymasterConfig)

Methods:

MethodDescription
connect(privateKey)Connect a user's wallet
setFactory(address)Set the SimpleAccountFactory address
getSmartAccountAddress(owner, salt?)Get predicted account address
sendTransaction(tx)Send a gasless transaction
getPaymasterQuote()Get current gas quotes

Example:

const paymaster = new ConfluxPaymaster(config);
paymaster.connect('0x...'); // User's private key
const account = await paymaster.getOrCreateAccount();
const result = await paymaster.sendTransaction({
  to: '0x...',
  data: '0x...'
});

subsections.title: TypeScript Types
subsections.content:
Core Types:

interface SponsoredTransaction {
  to: Address;        // Target contract
  data?: Hex;          // Encoded call data
  value?: bigint;      // Native token value
}

interface SponsoredTransactionResult {
  userOpHash: string;    // UserOperation hash
  txHash?: string;     // Transaction hash (after inclusion)
  success: boolean;    // Success status
}

interface PaymasterQuote {
  maxFeePerGas: string;
  maxPriorityFeePerGas: string;
  gasPrice: string;
}

All types are exported from the SDK:

import {
  ConfluxPaymaster,
  PaymasterConfig,
  SponsoredTransaction,
  SponsoredTransactionResult,
  PaymasterQuote
} from 'conflux-paymaster-sdk';

subsections.title: VerifyingPaymaster.sol
subsections.content:
The VerifyingPaymaster contract verifies signatures and sponsors gas fees.

Key Functions:

FunctionDescription
validatePaymasterUserOp()Validates UserOp and verifies paymaster signature
getHash()Computes hash for signature verification
setVerifier()Updates the verifier address (owner only)
deposit()Adds funds for gas sponsorship

Deployment:

cd packages/contracts
npm run deploy:testnet

Verification:

npx hardhat verify --network confluxTestnet <address> <entryPoint> <verifier> <minStake> <unstakeDelay>

subsections.title: SimpleAccount.sol
subsections.content:
ERC-4337 compatible smart account implementation.

Key Functions:

FunctionDescription
execute()Execute a single transaction
executeBatch()Execute multiple transactions
validateUserOp()EntryPoint validation
transferOwnership()Transfer account ownership

Features:

  • Sub-account support via salt
  • Access control with owner
  • Native token support (receive())
  • Replay protection via nonce

subsections.title: SimpleAccountFactory.sol
subsections.content:
Deploys SimpleAccount contracts deterministically using CREATE2.

Key Functions:

FunctionDescription
createAccount()Deploy new SimpleAccount for owner
getAddress()Predict account address before deploy
accountExists()Check if account is deployed

Address Calculation:

Accounts are deployed using CREATE2 with:

  • owner address
  • salt (nonce for multiple accounts per owner)
  • Factory bytecode

This ensures deterministic addresses that can be predicted before deployment.

subsections.title: Signing Service
subsections.content:
The backend signing service securely signs UserOperations to sponsor gas fees.

Endpoints:

EndpointMethodDescription
/healthGETHealth check
/api/paymaster/signPOSTSign UserOperation
/api/paymaster/quoteGETGet gas price quote

Signing Flow:

  1. SDK sends UserOperation to backend
  2. Backend validates the request (rate limiting, whitelisting)
  3. Backend computes hash and signs with verifier key
  4. Backend returns paymasterAndData signature

Security:

  • Rate limiting per user/IP
  • Request validation
  • Key stored securely (not exposed to client)

subsections.title: Basic Integration
subsections.content:
A complete example of integrating Conflux Paymaster SDK:

import { ConfluxPaymaster } from 'conflux-paymaster-sdk';
import { encodeFunctionData, parseAbi } from 'viem';

// Initialize
const paymaster = new ConfluxPaymaster({
  rpcUrl: 'https://evmtestnet.confluxrpc.com',
  paymasterAddress: '0x0cDE16Cf1fD5Bf2536069Aec8a2eF0832A27577B',
  signingServiceUrl: 'https://conflux-paymaster.onrender.com',
  chainId: 71,
});

// Connect user
await paymaster.connect(userPrivateKey);

// Set factory
await paymaster.setFactory('0xcF2acdAEde6bb2549647CA5eE52fe5b86757d01E');

// ERC-20 transfer example
const transferData = encodeFunctionData({
  abi: parseAbi(['function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)']),
  functionName: 'transfer',
  args: [recipientAddress, BigInt(1e18)]
});

// Send gasless transaction
const result = await paymaster.sendTransaction({
  to: tokenAddress,
  data: transferData,
});

console.log('Success! UserOp:', result.userOpHash);

subsections.title: Next.js Integration
subsections.content:
Integrating with a Next.js frontend:

// lib/paymaster.ts
import { ConfluxPaymaster } from 'conflux-paymaster-sdk';

const paymaster = new ConfluxPaymaster({
  rpcUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CONFLUX_RPC_URL!,
  paymasterAddress: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYMASTER_ADDRESS!,
  signingServiceUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SIGNING_SERVICE_URL!,
  chainId: parseInt(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID || '71') as 71 | 1030,
});

export default paymaster;

Then use in your components:

import paymaster from '@/lib/paymaster';

await paymaster.connect(privateKey);
const result = await paymaster.sendTransaction({
  to: contractAddress,
  data: txData
});

subsections.title: ERC-20 Transfer
subsections.content:
Example: Transferring ERC-20 tokens gas-free

import { ConfluxPaymaster, encodeFunctionData } from 'conflux-paymaster-sdk';

const paymaster = new ConfluxPaymaster(config);
await paymaster.connect(userPrivateKey);

});

const result = await paymaster.sendTransaction({

subsections.title: Security Best Practices
subsections.content:
For dApp Developers:

  1. Never expose signing keys - Always use the backend service
  2. Implement rate limiting - Prevent abuse of your sponsorship
  3. Validate user addresses - Only sponsor known/verified users
  4. Monitor paymaster balance - Set up alerts for low balance
  5. Use environment variables - Never hardcode sensitive data

Backend Security:

  • Store keys in secrets manager (AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault)
  • Rotate signing keys regularly
  • Implement IP-based rate limiting
  • Log all signing requests for auditing

subsections.title: Rate Limiting
subsections.content:
Implement rate limiting in your backend:

// Example with express-rate-limit
import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';

const limiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 24 hours
  max: 100, // limit each IP to 100 requests per window
  message: 'Too many requests, please try again tomorrow'
});

app.use('/api/paymaster/', limiter);

Recommended Limits:

dApp TypeRecommended Daily Limit
DeFi50 transactions/day
Gaming100 transactions/day
NFT20 transactions/day

subsections.title: Common Errors
subsections.content:
Error: 'Insufficient paymaster balance'
Solution: Fund your VerifyingPaymaster contract with CFX

Error: 'Invalid signature'
Solution: Verify your signing service is running and keys are correct

Error: 'UserOperation reverted'
Solution: Check the target contract and data encoding

Error: 'Factory not set'
Solution: Call setFactory(factoryAddress) before sending transactions

Error: 'Account not deployed'
Solution: Ensure the SimpleAccount is deployed - fund the address for deployment

subsections.title: Debugging
subsections.content:
Enable debug logging:

const paymaster = new ConfluxPaymaster({
  ...config,
  debug: true
});

Check contract deployment:

npx hardhat run scripts/verify.ts --network confluxTestnet

Check bundler status:

curl -X POST <bundler-url> \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_getUserOperationByHash","params":["<userOpHash>"],"id":1}'
